CandidateCreate.description: Manual place draft (curator research sheet). Starts in CONTENT_REVIEW.
CandidateCreate.title: CandidateCreate

chunks.description: Chunks of the working corpus revision, one per section and locale.
chunks.title: Chunks

CandidateReview.description:
Partial update against ``expected_content_revision``; increments content_revision.

An explicit ``null`` clears ``category_code``/``area_code``/visit minutes; absent fields
are unchanged. Facts are written only through ``/admin/places/{place_id}/facts``.
CandidateReview.title: CandidateReview

content.description: Original narrative text; never operational facts (hours, prices, addresses).
content.title: Content

review_state.description: APPROVED is applied only when the embedding is stored; else stays DRAFT with warning CHUNK_APPROVAL_DEFERRED.
review_state.title: Review State

ClosureRuleCreate.description:
Params shape by rule_kind (schema.sql place_closure_rules.params):
WEEKLY {weekdays:[1..7], from?, to?}; DATE {dates:[YYYY-MM-DD]} | {month_day:[MM-DD]};
LUNAR_DATE {lunar_days:[1..30], lunar_months:[1..12]|null}; SEASON {from_month_day,
to_month_day}; TICKET_VALIDITY {valid_same_day:true} | {valid_hours:1..168}.

city_id.description: AREA/CITY rules; defaults to the enabled city.
city_id.title: City Id

severity.description: Defaults to BLOCKING for CLOSED, WARNING otherwise.
severity.title: Severity

FactCreate.description: A new DRAFT revision of one fact field. ``value`` is required iff KNOWN.
FactCreate.title: FactCreate

verified_at.description: When the curator verified the evidence; defaults to now.
verified_at.title: Verified At

FactUpdate.description: Edit a DRAFT fact revision; approved revisions are immutable (new revision instead).

corpus_revision.description: Working corpus revision of the place (null when it has no chunks).
corpus_revision.title: Corpus Revision
